name: A release that breaks clients
label: Breaking release
description: A required project ID, fewer queues, a smaller CPU limit, and changed response types.

name: An additive release
label: Compatible change
description: Optional input for a closed request schema, more accepted queues, and an added health endpoint.

name: A rule outside the profile
label: Review required
description: A new regular expression needs a dedicated validator. Boundary keeps the CI gate closed.

name: Same edit, opposite impact
label: Direction matters
description: An enum addition widens accepted requests but also widens emitted responses.
